== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Evader (PC 2023 D-E1 card)]]. Compared with [[Evader (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]]. The whole 2019 disc card image and the whole 2023 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>e888ec80ad8170b1503cbfa38f492f9402a10c5d</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
